localFeatureCandidates.scope: Clearance-only cut using exact Minkowski swept jaw+pad (+Y32) or face (-Z48), with 0.15 mm clearance. No retention, tool, strength or complete assembly acceptance.

decision.jawSupport: Redesign the added closed bearing as a removable bearing cheek/keeper. A simple open slot only resolves loose-bench entry and is not retained. Do not recommend forcing PLA.
decision.lowerShell: Redesign a removable mouth-side access cheek together with support keeper so jaw can enter from motor-output-compatible +Y direction after shell/support/motor placement. Merely opening the bottom bearing slot or swapping shell/jaw order is insufficient.
decision.cap: Revise the localized face-engagement rail/undercut for a clear insertion path, or make it separately retained after cap placement. Do not recommend spreading cap sides: 3 mm each side increases intersection. Swept local relief removes 347.46 mm3 (0.92 percent of cap) and clears cap-versus-face rigid descent only.
decision.remainingEngineering: Positive keeper retention and complete assembly/tool/structure verification; no whole-head redesign is justified by these local failures alone.
